integrity: The proof is finite and self-contained. A standalone standard-library verifier exhaustively checks all \(4^8\) interpretation functions and independently confirms the structural characterization and transition count.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies generation-independent interpretation functions for the binary \((4)^2/3\) WOM problem and reachable second-write transitions only. It does not classify update-function values on unreachable states, generation-dependent decoders, or larger WOM parameters.
title: Uniqueness of the three-cell, two-write Rivest–Shamir WOM decoder
